usage: 日本 is a noun referring to the country Japan.
You can use 日本 when talking about travel, geography, food, or culture related to Japan.
It can stand alone or combine with other nouns to form compound words, such as 日本人 (Japanese person), 日本菜 (Japanese food), and 日本文化 (Japanese culture).
It is a very common everyday word in Cantonese.
